# Issue #301: remove the deprecated handler

We still ship the deprecated handler in `api/handlers.py`. Remove it and its
registration so it no longer appears in `registry()`. Everything else must keep
working.

arguments.summary: Removed the deprecated `legacy_export` handler from `api/handlers.py` and its entry in `_REGISTRY`. The `registry()` function now only returns the current handlers (`ping`, `export_v2`, `stats`). All existing tests still pass.
